title: REPT with a non-integer count truncates it

source.quote: If num_times is not an integer, it is truncated.
source.supports: Microsoft Learn: the count is truncated

source.quote: If NumberOfTimes is not an integer, it is rounded to the closest integer.
source.supports: DAX Guide: the count is rounded

derivation: 2.7 truncates to 2: "ab" twice is "abab". The expectation follows Microsoft Learn (and Excel, which truncates).
alternative: DAX Guide says the count is rounded to the closest integer: 2.7 becomes 3 and the result is "ababab".
